title: Management bridge v1
description: The complete set of management methods the plugin bridge may call. Closed on purpose: an open method set would let a new method appear without a schema, an effect and a review, which is exactly the `plugin/install`-as-authorization-bypass failure this design forbids.

prefix.description: Every management method carries this prefix. Business methods do not: the bridge reaches only the plugin' own authorized backend.

responseVariants.description: The full `OperationResult` discriminator set. `unknown` is mandatory: a crashed or drained operation whose outcome was never committed must be reportable as unknown rather than being guessed as rejected. Guessing it `rejected` would let a plugin retry a write that actually landed.
